title: hyv-strict-check
description: Run the local strict AI-pattern and calibrated voice-match gate.

required: at least five local writing-sample paths

evidence_requirements: Report the exact local result, including readiness and every blocking or review finding.
Never call strict-ready a fact, authorship, or publication verdict.
stop_conditions: Stop when a Profile v3, enough samples, or calibrated metric tolerances are missing.
Stop when the result is blocked or needs human review; do not change the draft or learning state.

tool_free_mode.behavior: Provide the required inputs and explain that no strict result was run.
